senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Sihon, King of the Amorites.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 60b:13">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 38a:3">Gitt. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>עמון זמואב טהרו בס׳</he> the districts of Ammon and Moab became permitted (a legitimate conquest) to the Israelites through Sihon (who had conquered them from Ammon and Moab, and from whom Israel took them by the right of conquest).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 78b:14">B. Bath. 78ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00600"><he>סִיחָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:5">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>כפר סיחון</he> (some ed. <he>סיחין</he>; oth. <he>שיחין</he>), v. <cite ref="U00871"><he>שִׁיחִין</he></cite>.]
